name: oxmutate
description: Mutation testing on the oxc engine: Stryker-compatible, warm in-process runs inside Vitest, CI lanes, SARIF and an agent surface. No dependency outside the burgee family.

scripts.build:native: cd native && cargo build --release --features napi --lib && node ../scripts/copy-binding.mjs
